title: JARVIS_VOICE_ASSISTANT_ARCHITECTURE
universal_lens: The sovereign voice bridge is modeled as a non-blocking stochastic pipeline mapping semantic intent to acoustic realization. It unifies asynchronous queuing, zero-cost routing, and deterministic fallbacks into a continuous-time Markov decision process, ensuring ultra-low latency while maintaining strict operational sovereignty across disconnected or rate-limited network states.
gsi_mapping: In GSI, the watchdog daemon acts as a conformal inference monitor. When an NFL prop clears RVC with expected value exceeding ten percent, the system triggers a high-priority broadcast. The voice interface translates these probabilistic edges into immediate auditory alerts, bridging abstract Bayesian updates to real-time human cognition.
gse_mapping: GSE situational reasoning relies on the agent bus topology. Priority dispatches from peer agents like Motif or Jules transition the system state, prompting JARVIS to announce events. This ensures the prediction engine's internal state transitions are continuously synchronized with the operator's awareness without blocking background trading loops.

primitives.name: Zero-Cost Sovereign Voice Routing Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Inspired by Aria's setup (`AKCodez/make-your-own-jarvis`), the architecture replaces heavy, subscription-laden proprietary voice UIs with an ultra-low-latency, zero-cost pipeline combining: 1.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: Latency L measured in milliseconds (ms). Cost C is dimensionless (zero-tier). Pipeline throughput T in utterances per second.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes stable local compute for SAPI fallback and intermittent availability of the Fish Audio developer API.
primitives.breakdown_regime: System degrades to local SAPI if network connectivity drops below threshold or Fish Audio returns HTTP 429/503 errors.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a fault-tolerant message queue where primary consumers are cloud-based TTS endpoints and secondary consumers are local COM objects.
layer2.telemetry: End-to-end text-to-speech latency and fallback trigger frequency.

primitives.name: Asynchronous Speech Worker Daemon
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Non-Blocking Telemetry & Watchdog Daemon**: Background speech worker (`SpeechWorker`) queues utterances asynchronously, ensuring background monitors and trading engines never block on voice output.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: Queue depth Q (dimensionless integer). Blocking time B = 0 seconds. Processing rate lambda in events per second.
primitives.assumptions: Memory allocation for the asynchronous queue is bounded; trading engine thread priority strictly exceeds speech worker priority.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Queue overflow leading to dropped announcements if event generation rate vastly exceeds audio playback duration.

layer2.mapping: Maps to a producer-consumer kernel decoupling high-frequency quantitative edge detection from low-frequency human-machine interaction channels.
layer2.telemetry: Maximum queue depth observed during peak agent bus activity.

primitives.name: Expected Value Edge Announcer
primitives.verbatim_quote: A new investment-grade prop or game edge clears RVC and exceeds 10% EV, 2.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: Expected Value EV as a percentage (%). Threshold tau = 0.10. RVC confidence score in [0, 1].
primitives.assumptions: RVC (Real Value Calculation) provides unbiased probability estimates; market odds are accurately scraped and normalized.
primitives.breakdown_regime: False positive broadcasts if RVC model suffers from concept drift or market data feed latency introduces stale odds.

layer2.mapping: Directly maps to a conformal prediction filter triggering a state-transition event when the nonconformity score crosses the alpha quantile.
layer2.telemetry: Frequency of EV > 10% triggers versus realized ROI on executed props.

reasoning_traces.think:
The JARVIS architecture functions as a multi-layered stochastic control system designed to minimize cognitive load while maximizing quantitative edge capture. Mathematically, we define the core operation as a mapping from a high-dimensional latent space of sportsbook odds and agent bus messages to a one-dimensional acoustic waveform. The `SpeechWorker` acts as a discrete-event simulator, managing an asynchronous FIFO queue to ensure that the computational graph of the GSE prediction engine remains entirely decoupled from I/O bottlenecks. By enforcing a zero-blocking constraint, the system guarantees that the evaluation of investment-grade props—specifically those clearing the Real Value Calculation (RVC) with an Expected Value (EV) greater than 10%—is never delayed by text-to-speech synthesis latencies. The routing mechanism introduces a conditional probability distribution over available TTS backends. Primarily, it utilizes the Fish Audio S2.1 Pro Developer API, constrained by a temporal validity flag (free through November 30, 2026). If the primary backend fails due to rate limits (HTTP 429) or network partition, the system instantaneously collapses the wavefunction to a local Windows SAPI state. This duality between cloud-native persona fidelity and local deterministic fallback creates a robust, fault-tolerant operator. Furthermore, the integration with the agent bus allows peer entities like Motif or Jules to inject high-priority interrupts directly into the acoustic channel, effectively treating the voice assistant as a shared memory bus for human-machine coordination.

reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: This architecture inherits its lineage from early expert systems utilizing rule-based alerting, evolving through the adoption of asynchronous event-driven architectures in high-frequency trading. The specific implementation mirrors modern microservices patterns, replacing monolithic voice assistants with composable, zero-cost APIs. Historically, it bridges the gap between passive dashboard monitoring and active, interrupt-driven cognitive augmentation, drawing direct inspiration from open-source projects like `make-your-own-jarvis` but hardening it for quantitative rigor.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: The system models Garrett not merely as a user, but as a central node in a distributed multi-agent network requiring constant situational awareness. Opposing agents in this domain are the volatile sports markets and the competing algorithms of other bettors. JARVIS anticipates Garrett's need for immediate, frictionless access to high-EV opportunities, acting as a proactive filter that suppresses noise and amplifies signal. It understands that during live NFL action, visual attention is fragmented, thus prioritizing the auditory channel to deliver critical RVC clearances and agent bus dispatches without demanding manual intervention.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: To prevent catastrophic feedback loops or information leakage, strict anti-collinearity vetoes are enforced. The voice pipeline must never block the execution threads of the trading engine; if the `SpeechWorker` queue saturates, older non-critical notifications are silently dropped to preserve system responsiveness. Additionally, security doctrines mandate that no proprietary secrets or raw API keys traverse the voice channel or are logged in plaintext. The automatic downgrade to local SAPI serves as a crucial veto against external dependency failures, ensuring that even under complete network isolation, the sovereign mind retains full diagnostic and interactive capabilities over the GSE infrastructure.
